issue.title: Bash completion not working correctly
issue.body:
## My urfave/cli version is

`v3.9.0`

## Checklist

- [X] Are you running the latest v3 release? The list of releases is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/releases).
- [X] Did you check the manual for your release? The v3 manual is [here](https://cli.urfave.org/v3/getting-started/)
- [X] Did you perform a search about this problem? Here's the [GitHub guide](https://help.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/using-search-to-filter-issues-and-pull-requests) about searching.

## Dependency Management

<!--
  Delete any of the following that do not apply:
-->

- My project is using go modules.


## Describe the bug

When completion is loaded, I can do completion in the shell. However, after a completed word, no space is being appended, so I need to enter a space myself to get to the next subcommand completion and so forth.

## To reproduce

I have enabled completions with `EnableShellCompletion: true` and sourced it. 

## Observed behavior

Then when I try to complete for instance this command: `esctl ccr follower pause` I need to enter these chars:

`esctl ccr<TAB><SPC>f<TAB><SPC>p<TAB><RET>`

Bash completions do usually not work that way.

## Expected behavior

I'd expect to only enter this:

`esctl ccr<TAB>f<TAB>p<TAB><RET>`

## Additional context

Source: https://codeberg.org/scip/esctl

## Run `go version` and paste its output here

```
go1.23.5 linux/amd64
